reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Maryland
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
*/

/* =========================
   1) Statute translations
   ========================= */

/*
  MD. State Finance and Procurement Code Ann.  8-216 (2021)
  "Grant anticipation notes may not be sold under this Part III of this subtitle
   until the State unit receives from the grantor a written commitment for the grant."
*/

% statute_md_sfp_8_216_requires_written_commitment_before_sale(+StateUnit,+Grantor,+Grant,+Part,+Subtitle,+Year)
% Encodes the condition precedent for selling grant anticipation notes.
statute_md_sfp_8_216_requires_written_commitment_before_sale(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant, part_iii, subtitle_8, 2021) :-
    state_unit(StateUnit),
    grantor(Grantor),
    grant(Grant).

% statute_md_sfp_8_216_permitted_to_sell_notes(+StateUnit,+Grantor,+Grant,+Part,+Subtitle,+Year)
% True when sale is permitted under  8-216 (2021).
statute_md_sfp_8_216_permitted_to_sell_notes(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant, part_iii, subtitle_8, 2021) :-
    statute_md_sfp_8_216_requires_written_commitment_before_sale(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant, part_iii, subtitle_8, 2021),
    received_written_commitment(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant).

% statute_md_sfp_8_216_prohibited_to_sell_notes(+StateUnit,+Grantor,+Grant,+Part,+Subtitle,+Year)
% True when sale is prohibited under  8-216 (2021).
statute_md_sfp_8_216_prohibited_to_sell_notes(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant, part_iii, subtitle_8, 2021) :-
    statute_md_sfp_8_216_requires_written_commitment_before_sale(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant, part_iii, subtitle_8, 2021),
    \+ received_written_commitment(StateUnit, Grantor, Grant).

/* =========================
   2) Scenario facts
   ========================= */

% The question's scenario is minimal: it concerns the bailiff and whether law empowers
% them to execute a writ of eviction. We encode that "bailiff" is the person in question.
person(bailiff).
role(bailiff, bailiff_role).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    person(bailiff),
    role(bailiff, bailiff_role).

/* =========================
   Background domain facts (for statute predicates)
   ========================= */

% Minimal domain vocabulary to keep statute predicates well-formed and deterministic.
% (Not used for the eviction question, but required to make statute predicates meaningful.)
state_unit(example_state_unit).
grantor(example_grantor).
grant(example_grant).

% No facts asserted for received_written_commitment/3 in this scenario.
% This reflects that the scenario does not involve grant anticipation notes.

/* =========================
   3) Reasoning: "empowered by law"
   ========================= */

% In this program, a person is "empowered by law" to do an act if some encoded statute
% grants/authorizes that act. We derive authorizations only from the translated statutes.
authorized_by_law(_Person, _Act) :-
    % No authorization in MD SFP  8-216 (2021) concerns executing writs of eviction.
    fail.

% The specific legal question asked:
legal_empowered_to_execute_writ_of_eviction(Person) :-
    authorized_by_law(Person, execute_writ_of_eviction).

/* =========================
   4) housing_answer/1 (deterministic)
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_empowered_to_execute_writ_of_eviction(bailiff),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   5) Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
